segments.description: Payments and financial infrastructure company serving merchants, political campaigns, and nonprofit organizations underserved by traditional financial institutions.
segments.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, PSQ Holdings, Inc. operates under one reportable segment: Financial Technology ("Financial Technology" or "FinTech").

revenueModel.text: Merchants, campaigns, and nonprofit organizations pay the company for consumer financing, payment processing, and fundraising platform services.
revenueModel.evidence: Through Credova and PSQ Payments, the Company offers merchants access to both consumer financing and payment processing solutions.
